subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Is #90865 sufficiently reproduced to authorize repair work now, or should maintainers require live Discord or focused integration proof first?
rationale: Current source already contains a generic `channels.discord` hot-reload restart path, so choosing a fix without proving where that path failed could land the wrong behavior or add an unnecessary parallel reload command.

options.title: Require live/focused proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open with needs-info/manual-review until a live Discord repro or targeted integration harness identifies the missed reload link.

options.title: Authorize source investigation now
options.body: Allow an owner to build a focused harness around config patch, channel restart, and Discord provider allowlist rebuild without waiting for new reporter proof.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Treat the existing generic reload path as sufficient, accepting the risk that the later v2026.6.1 report was a real unproven regression.

recommendation.title: Require live/focused proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open with needs-info/manual-review until a live Discord repro or targeted integration harness identifies the missed reload link.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Discord provider allowlist setup and gateway reload surfaces.
